en.william-c-chittick: The right of the possessor of authority (sultan)

is that you know that God has made you a trial (fitna) for him. God is testing him through the authority He has given him over you. You should not expose yourself to his displeasure, for thereby you cast yourself by your own hands into destruction [1] and become his partner in his sin when he brings evil down upon you. [2]
